newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, seen oscillating.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, seen oscillating.

text.p: Slovenian shares edged higher on Friday but traders said the market lacked the impetus to break out of a narrow trading range in the coming week.
"Until parliament ratifies the association accord with the European Union no fresh money will flow in," a market participant said.
Parliament is expected to take a vote on the issue in the next two weeks.
* The blue chip SBI index firmed 0.96 points to 1,323.33.

* Bank SKB was most actively traded following Thursday's announcement it would buy 51 percent of bank UBK by end of June. SKB eased 0.14 percent to 49,100 tolars on volume of 146 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-12-58439
